            Polyline((0,0), (base_radius, 0), (base_radius, total_length - tip_length - reduced_section_length),
                     (tip_radius, total_length - tip_length), (tip_radius, total_length), (0, total_length), close=True)
        make_face()
    revolve(axis=Axis.Y)

solid_body = p.part
top_face = solid_body.faces().sort_by(Axis.Y)[-1]
solid_body = chamfer(top_face.edges(), chamfer_distance)

part = solid_body
part.name = "revolved_chamfered_part"
export_step(part, "output.step")
